summary.text: Teresa Ibach is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who has represented District 44 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a farmer, rancher and property manager.

paragraphs.text: Ibach was born in Lincoln, Nebraska, and graduated from Sumner-Eddyville-Miller High School in 1980.
She earned a B.S. in human resources and family sciences from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 1984.
Her career experience includes working as a farmer and rancher and a property manager.

According to Ballotpedia, she served on the boards of the NEBRASKAland Foundation, the Nebraska Farm Bureau Foundation, the Nebraska FFA Foundation and the Nebraska 4-H Foundation, and as a trustee of the University of Nebraska Foundation.
Ibach assumed office in the Nebraska Legislature on January 4, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as vice chair of Agriculture and member of Business and Labor and Revenue.
She advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary.
